limitations: This is the ledger/runtime foundation, not later Identity/Lineage or Dynamic Applicability. The supported authority model is the canonical shared local repository and linked worktrees; a clone without its trusted key must fail closed. Preserve F048/F049 and existing accountable follow-up drafts keyed-ledgers-survive-reclone and finding-ledger-nonblocking-review-followups; compatibility accounting is not signed deferral. F055/F056 have source fixes but remain formally open until current REVIEW closure. F057 diagnostics are fixed, while a complete observed validation is still required to close the runtime interruption. Topology observe/inconclusive evidence is not a passed topology proof. No downstream Story or unrelated feature was implemented. pitfalls: Use the repository-local CLI in the unmerged worktree. Refresh evidence only after all source/build/merge writes stop; material or Story-owned drift cannot be relabeled fresh. A changed reviewer run makes an older open Finding stale even if source hashes are unchanged; repair and resolve the preserved Finding rather than weakening latest-run protection. Earlier full validation queued about 783 seconds and later refused at 1594.3 seconds; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 did not prove its cause. The new safe diagnostics distinguish lease, preflight verification and fact changes without printing secret values; the passive observer at /tmp/bfe8f-validation-observer.YPZEBu/observe-validation.mjs preserves raw CLI output and fingerprints only, issuing no evidence. Main sync must preserve separate raw process reuse and selector-specific receipt identities; never collapse timeout/provenance, cross-contaminate selector failures, discard complete-output receipt matching or remove mandatory tests.
